channel.title: Top Gear
channel.desc: Jeremy Clarkson and James May investigate an increasingly popular type of tall hatchback often referred to as a `crossover'. Meanwhile, Richard Hammond is in Italy driving a pair of Lamborghinis, the sensational Aventador Roadster and a 570 horsepower riot of carbon fibre and space age styling called the Sesto Elemento. Plus, James May is at the test track to drive a modern recreation of the classic Porsche 911.
